reference: Independent int64 convolution, checked against every output after every timed batch
notes: Raw ticks are whole-batch elapsed time, including calls, traversal, barriers, and timer reads.
Preparation, reference calculation, output verification, and debugger extraction are outside timing.
Warm steady-state trials, one firmware startup per clock/compiler setting.
M0+ slept during filtering; DSP and scalar process identical inputs and coefficients.
Best means fastest among the tested direct-FIR kernels, compiler options, and clock settings.
No parallel scheduler or cross-core speedup is measured here.
